title.narrative: Get Skilled! Expansion of non-formal business-based vocational education and training in Uganda

description.narrative: Lack of vocational qualifications and high youth unemployment are key problems in Uganda. In P3365, the business association USSIA successfully built the training capacity of 73 small enterprises in the greater Kampala area. USSIA has now strategically anchored vocational training in the association. Phase 2 will build on these successes and innovatively deepen them.

Objective: The (self-)employment and income situation of young people and women in Kampala, Wakiso and Mukono has improved.Outcome:1200 young people and 300 women use the education and training and services offered by USSIA to achieve sustainable income.

The direct target group is composed of the following categories:(a) 1000 unemployed young people.(b) 200 young people who have already been supported in P3365 but still need urgent support in setting up their small business(c) 300 women who run a small (most) business(d) 125 (spouse) partners of the female target group(e) 50 trainers(f) 56 community-based trainers
